title: Alignment Canvas & Initiative Release Signal Protocol
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a concise, shared artifact that (1) makes company-level priorities visible in the language of teams and releases, and (2) produces deterministic "release signals" that trigger cross-team rollups and gating decisions. Current OKR mappings are scattered across decks and spreadsheets, causing late-stage misalignment during sprint planning and release windows.

Proposal: Create an "Alignment Canvas" (one-page canonical artifact) plus a lightweight "Release Signal Protocol" that defines the conditions under which an initiative changes state (e.g., green -> amber -> red) and how that state propagates to dependent teams and the roadmap calendar. The Canvas will map objective -> measurable outcomes -> owning initiatives -> critical milestones -> release signal conditions. The Protocol will define signal types, ownership, escalation path, and billing/priority implications (where applicable).

Scope: Company-level OKRs and cross-functional initiatives (growth, runtime, console, enterprise). Interfaces to: product roadmaps, engineering sprint plans, release calendar, and executive review cadence. Out of scope: team-level sprint artifacts, hiring/resource allocation trackers (handled separately).

Trade-offs: A strict protocol reduces ambiguity but adds overhead for rapid experiments. We will start with a minimal signal set (Green/Amber/Red + Hold) and iterate based on feedback. Templates will be lightweight to avoid becoming a second source-of-truth.

Stakeholders: PM org (lead: Aisha Patel), Eng leads (Marco Chen, Priya Natarajan), Design (Nina Gomez), GTM (Lucas Morgan), Finance (Samantha Li).

Success metrics: Reduction in last-week-of-cycle re-scopes by 50% (measured across 3 major initiatives), time-to-decision in escalation from 72h -> 24h, and stable mapping of 90% of company primary initiatives to the Canvas by the Q2 planning checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Alignment Canvas template created and stored in Confluence/Drive with example filled for three pilot initiatives (runtime-1.18, console-2026.02, dedicated-commit).
2) Release Signal Protocol doc authored with definitions, owner roles, and escalation flow; reviewed by Eng, PM, Design, and Finance.
3) Lightweight UI mock (Console) demonstrating how a signal would appear on an initiative card (Figma link).
4) Pilot run: 3 initiatives adopt the Canvas for one cycle; we collect before/after change logs for at least two gating decisions.
5) Rollup script (or spreadsheet) that ingests Canvas outputs and produces an executive status dashboard; initial automation POC exists in a GitHub repo.
6) Post-pilot retrospective with clear decision to adopt, iterate, or sunset the protocol.
